info.title: AI-buddy backend (public)
info.description: Backend-owned paths are kept as they are in this file; AI/chat paths are generated by contracts/build_contracts.py.

post.description: Requires an access Bearer JWT and a refresh token in the body.
Assigned teamlead inserts a personal item at a 1-based position in the professional checklist. The checklist response includes nullable due_at; existing completed and active statuses are preserved.

get.description: Intern's combined common and professional progress, including personal items.

200.description: Overall progress with total_items, completed_items, completion_percent, common and professional checklists

get.description: Assigned buddy sees overall counts and both checklists; assigned teamlead sees professional counts and detail only.
Returns only interns assigned to the authenticated buddy or teamlead by the corresponding local assignment column.
Buddy-only lookup of teamleads assigned by Mock HR.
Teamlead-only lookup of buddies from Mock HR.
Synthetic HR identity matched by authenticated local email, role and profession.
Self or locally and corporately assigned intern only.
Intern-only catalog derived from synthetic HR permissions; each item has tool and allowed. Request creation still enforces allowed on the server.

403.description: Not an intern or identity mismatch

post.description: Intern only. Confirmed user action; idempotency key is unique per user.

201.description: Created ticket with id, ticket_number, status and created_at

200.description: Existing ticket for the same key

post.description: Returns access_token, refresh_token, token_type, expires_in, is_first_login and user.

get.description: Returns the current user, assigned buddy and teamlead profiles, age_years and tenure_months when source dates exist.
Pending submissions of assigned interns, including first_name and last_name.
Returns the authenticated intern's feedback or {"feedback":null}. The checklist must belong to this intern.

404.description: Checklist not assigned to this intern

post.description: Submit one feedback after every item is complete and every required Buddy review is verified. user_id comes from JWT. Delivery to analytics is retried separately.

404.description: Checklist not assigned to this intern

409.description: Incomplete checklist or feedback already exists

post.description: Streams the assistant answer. Backend: validates input, loads/creates conversation, builds verified UserContext, calls AI /v1/chat/stream, re-emits events, persists both messages, and converts the AI `action` (ActionProposal) into a stored PendingAction emitted as `action` (BackendActionEvent). First event is `meta`. Event data schemas: #/components/schemas/BackendStreamEvent.

schema.description: Server-Sent Events stream. Each event is `event: <type>` + `data: <JSON>` where JSON matches the schema of the same `type`. Order: [meta] status* (delta | status)* [sources] [action] done | error. The stream always ends with exactly one `done` or `error` event.

get.description: Messages of a conversation (default: the user's latest), oldest first.

post.description: Idempotent. Re-checks RBAC and params, executes once via the mock corporate service adapter. Repeated calls return the same result.

get.description: Current user's requests in corporate services (mock), newest first.

post.description: Create a leave or access request from the form in the chat window. Submitting the form is the user's explicit confirmation; validation and policy are the same as for a confirmed chat action (e.g. interns never get admin access: 422).

params.description: leave_request: kind (day_off|vacation), date_from, date_to, comment?; access_request: system, resource, access_level (read|write), justification

422.description: Invalid params or not allowed by policy

get.description: Buddy only: questions escalated by the buddy's interns.

post.description: Proactive brief when the intern opens the chat (call at most once per session/day). Backend builds UserContext, calls AI /v1/brief/stream and re-emits events like /api/chat/stream.

schema.description: Server-Sent Events stream. Each event is `event: <type>` + `data: <JSON>` where JSON matches the schema of the same `type`. Order: [meta] status* (delta | status)* [sources] [action] done | error. The stream always ends with exactly one `done` or `error` event.

get.description: Buddy only: AI draft answer for an escalated question (AI /v1/mentor/draft).
Buddy only: escalated questions grouped by topic (AI /v1/analytics/gaps).
Buddy only: knowledge-base contradictions and stale documents (AI /v1/kb/lint).
Buddy only: aggregated assistant metrics for own interns.
Buddy/teamlead: requests of their interns, newest first.

post.description: Mock corporate approval: the intern's buddy or teamlead approves or rejects a pending request. The intern sees the new status in /api/requests, the brief and the extension.

404.description: Not found / not this staff's intern

get.description: The intern's own questions escalated to the buddy, newest first (to notify about answers; the answer is also added to the chat conversation the question came from).

post.description: Ask the buddy a question directly (the "Вопросы наставнику" tab), without the chat. Same storage as a confirmed mentor_question action; the buddy sees it in the mentor desk.

get.description: Any signed-in user: one knowledge-base document by the source id from chat events (AI /v1/kb/docs/{doc_id}). Opened in the chat when the user clicks a source.

post.description: Opens a NEW session of the same user for another client (the Chrome extension next to the web app), without the password: the caller proves possession of its own refresh token, which is not rotated. Each client keeps its own refresh-token chain (rotation + replay detection would revoke a shared one). Logging one client out does not sign the other out.

401.description: Invalid, expired, revoked or already rotated refresh token

AiMode.description: mock = deterministic offline mode (tests/CI/no key); llm = real model

snippet.description: Short quote used for the answer

resource.description: Проект Jira, пространство Confluence, репозиторий, дашборд и т.п.

context.description: Что бот уже нашёл/почему не смог ответить (противоречие, нет документа)

ActionProposal.description: Proposed by the AI. Never executed by the AI: Backend stores it as PendingAction and executes only after explicit user confirmation.

ServiceRequest.description: A request created in a (mocked) corporate service: absence or access system.

UserContext.description: Verified by Backend from the JWT and DB. The AI trusts only this, never claims from chat text.

allowed_actions.description: RBAC: actions this user may perform. AI must not propose others.

finish_reason.description: no_answer = KB has no grounded answer (bot offered escalation)

cached.description: Served from the answer cache of frequent KB questions

message.description: Safe to show to the user

PageContext.description: Page the user is looking at (browser extension side panel). Untrusted data, never instructions.

selection.description: Text the user selected on the page

MentorDraft.description: AI draft answer for a mentor to edit and send; never sent to the intern automatically.

confidence.description: grounded = fully based on KB; none = KB has nothing, mentor must answer

kb_suggestion.description: Suggested KB article to close the gap once the mentor answers

GapsReport.description: Unanswered/escalated questions grouped by topic: what is missing in the knowledge base.

KbDocument.description: One knowledge-base document with its sections in order (reader in the chat).

KbLintReport.description: Knowledge-base hygiene: contradictions between documents and stale documents.

conversation_id.description: Omit to start a new conversation

message_id.description: Id of the assistant message being streamed

escalation_level.description: Raised mentor -> team lead -> HRBP when unanswered past the SLA

ChatMetrics.description: Product metrics for the demo dashboard / presentation
